It is a compact, squared shaped travel router that runs OpenWrt perfectly. GL.iNet ships the device with their own version of OpenWrt, but they also offer multiple clean OpenWrt images pre-built for their devices at [http://gl-inet.com/firmware/ FW]. The AR300M is identical in hardware to the ''GL.iNet AR300MD'', aside from the fact that it does not ship with the 5GHz module installed. Unlike other GL.iNet routers, this model has no PoE support (due to the 5GHz module taking up all the extra space). Power is provided by a Micro USB 5V 1A input. ==Links of Interest== :[https://store.gl-inet.com/collections/travel-routers/products/gl-ar300m-mini-smart-router Official Shop] ==Flashing== {{Flashnotice}} ===Flashing dd-wrt=== {{DDWRT |techdata = |wikipage = |forumpage = |github = |target = |subtarget = |arch = |support_commit_id = |support_started_version = donated router needed |current_supported_version = unknown |unsupportedfuncntions = |lan_hardware = |lan_comment = |wlan_hardware = |wlan_comment = |usb_sata_comment = |inst_method = |inst_comment = |rec_method = |rec_comment = |comment = }} Please insert instructions here ===Flashing OpenWrt=== {{OpenWrt |techdata = https://openwrt.org/toh/hwdata/gl.inet/gl.inet_gl-ar300m |wikipage = https://openwrt.org/toh/gl.inet/gl-ar300m |forumpage = https://forum.openwrt.org/t/gl-ar300m-sysupgrade-problem/1812 |forumpage2 = https://forum.openwrt.org/t/howto-upgrade-the-preinstalled-openwrt-lede-17-01-firmware-in-the-gl-ar300m-router/21129 |forumpage3 = |github = |target = ath79 |subtarget = nand |arch = mips_24kc |support_commit_id = d963ddf0424a551e5fadd561c934bfdb5d198764 |support_started_version = 17.01.0 |current_supported_version = 25.12.0 |last_supported_version = |image_too_big = |unsupportedfuncntions = NAND flash not supported until after 19.07.x, must be forced into booting from NOR flash |lan_hardware = Qualcomm Atheros QCA9531 |lan_comment = |wlan_hardware = Qualcomm Atheros QCA9531 |wlan_comment = "-EXT" suffix has 2 detachable Antennas (RP-SMA) |usb_sata_comment = |inst_method = Sysupgrade, U-Boot web recovery |inst_comment = |rec_method = U-Boot web recovery |rec_comment = |comment = Flashing to the 128MB NAND flash is supported in Snapshot ath79 at time of writing, removable external antennas on "ext" variant }} {{SCollapse | git • >> |
